title: Arninis Rage mod
description: A mod that annoyes the player into quiting their game!
body:
In this mod, I’ve tried my best I’m trying to find ways to actually make other players rage quit Minecraft to figure out how much this difficulty would be.

**What happens in this mod:**


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Any tool you use would break after 1 to 2 uses,
Random TNT with spawn on top of you, 
Hunger would be set to one ,
You’d be pushed by an invisible force by a bit ,
Random chunks would be deleted ,
Crafting table sometimes explode ,
Blocks you placed would sometimes get replaced to another block,

</details>
